text:
Welcome to Quang Phu Cau Incense Village! This charming craft village is nestled in the Ung Hoa area and is renowned for its vibrant, colorful incense sticks that are beautifully displayed drying in bundles in the workshop courtyards.

The village is free to enter, but keep in mind that some households and drying yards may charge a small fee for photography, typically around 50,000 to 100,000 VND per person. It's always a good idea to ask the workshop owners for permission before taking photos. 

The best time to visit is between 8:00 AM and 4:30 PM when you can see the incense sticks being dried. However, please note that the drying displays can depend on the weather and the production schedule of each workshop.

While there are no fixed hours for each workshop, this timeframe generally allows for a vibrant and fulfilling experience. Make sure to explore the different workshops, each offering its unique take on this beautiful craft. Enjoy your visit and immerse yourself in the rich tradition of incense making here at Quang Phu Cau!
